title: Claude Code settings source: 'settings' — Inline Plugin Declarations in settings.json
description: A new source: 'settings' field for plugin marketplace declarations, allowing plugin entries to be declared inline within settings.json rather than requiring a separate git-hosted repository. Prior to this, every plugin had to be hosted in a git repo. The inline declaration path enables rapid development of private plugins and project-local plugins without a full git hosting requirement. Companion feature: CLI tool usage detection added to plugin tips (in addition to file pattern matching), improving plugin discoverability.
redundancy_notes: Registry has managed-settings-dropin (v2.1.83, enterprise policy) and claude-marketplace-anthropic-20260317 (marketplace architecture) but neither covers inline plugin declarations for personal/project use. This is a different mechanism entirely.

evaluation.reasoning: Clear APPROVED above the 70 threshold. Zero integration friction: just a new JSON field in settings.json (score: 90). Removes a real barrier — previously, every private plugin required a git-hosted repo, which created overhead for project-local or personal tooling. The companion CLI tool detection for plugin tips is a quality-of-life improvement that pairs well. Token efficiency is neutral (score: 50) — this feature is about developer ergonomics, not token savings. Maintenance burden is near-zero (score: 95) — once declared in settings.json, no ongoing maintenance. Community validation is strong (score: 80) — official Anthropic changelog entry. Practical impact: the claude-evolution project could declare evolution-specific plugins inline in the workspace .claude/settings.json without needing a separate repo.
